xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5295: Workflow redesign D2: turn card, file chips, composer controls, subagents rail, tab strip

plan.title: Workflow redesign D2: turn card, file chips, composer controls, subagents rail, tab strip
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The parent PRD (PAN-5284 §9-§10) fixes D2 as one child: the rest of the conversation tab of mockup screen 1, after D1. It is split here into 19 small items; the file count comes from one new test file per new module, the pinned tests the parent requires be updated (not deleted), one Playwright spec with two screenshots, and three doc files. The three threads (turn card + chips, composer, tabs) share no files and run in parallel slots; splitting them into sibling issues would leave the screen half-converted between merges (parent D-13) and repeat the fixture UAT three times.

narratives.Problem: From a conversation, what the agent changed shows as a per-message "Changed files" tree with an inline diff panel that covers the chat; file paths in replies open an external editor; the composer controls use three styles (a raw "Auto" select, "High · set", a greyed model button); the subagents rail opens by default; Stage tabs grow without limit, show ⌘N chips on mac, and label untitled chats "Chat <hash>".
narratives.Proposal: Per PRD .pan/drafts/pan-5295.md: one ConversationChangesScope per panel shares the /changes query with the header; a TurnChangesCard per user turn replaces the Changed-files card (dock actions inside a Stage, the diff window outside); ⋯ gains Full diff in a new window; file chips open the dock diff or the file beside the chat; the composer toolbar moves to its own file and gets Send: <mode>, Thinking: <level> and an explaining model control in mockup order; the rail starts collapsed; tabs clamp with an "N tabs ▾" list, a registry-driven + menu and a "New conversation" fallback.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the server /changes, /diffs or /popout/diff routes, or to scope=turn semantics.
- No change to DiffPanel internals or the dock Changes chips ("Last turn" keeps its server meaning).
- No header, status line or ⋯ menu change beyond the one "Full diff in a new window" item.
- No new polling faster than 5 s and no new /changes caller beyond ConversationChangesScope (chips and cards never call the hook).
- No raise of any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row.
- No deleted or skipped tests; pinned tests are replaced.
- No Ledger-theme work beyond not breaking.
- No per-line attribution for non-Claude harnesses.

autoDecisions.summary: Outside a Stage the turn card still renders, from /changes with rootId null; its Review and rows open the /popout/diff window (D2-3).
autoDecisions.rationale: Today the Changed-files card and inline diff show in every mount; parent D-14 forbids dropping a function without a home, and §7 keeps /popout/diff. This replaces the /diffs request those mounts already made, at the same cadence, and avoids useRootContext outside a Stage.

autoDecisions.summary: ⋯ gains "Full diff in a new window" (D2-4).
autoDecisions.rationale: Removing the inline DiffPanel would leave Compare…, vs main, All turns, whitespace and Markdown preview unreachable; one menu item restores the only entry point.

autoDecisions.summary: Turn cards group by user turn on the client; Review opens the dock diff view over the turn's files instead of the server scope=turn (D2-5, D2-6).
autoDecisions.rationale: Server turn ids are per assistant message (uncommitted edits on mid-turn messages, commits on the last edited one), and scope=turn filters by one id, so it can miss part of a turn.

autoDecisions.summary: Show in files opens the Files tab filtered to "Only what this conversation changed" via a new filesFilter field on openDock (D2-7).
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches mockup action files-mine; the Files filter lived only in ExplorerPane state, so openDock needs one optional field.

autoDecisions.summary: Unchanged Markdown chips keep the persisted PAN-3260 open target instead of opening beside (D2-9).
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator saved that choice explicitly; Open beside is added to the context menu, so nothing is lost.

autoDecisions.summary: "Thinking: <level>" applies to every EffortPicker (composer, New conversation pickers, HomeComposer) (D2-12).
autoDecisions.rationale: It is one shared control; per-site labels would split one control into two styles, against FR-19.

autoDecisions.summary: The composer toolbar is extracted to ComposerToolbar.tsx first (D2-10).
autoDecisions.rationale: ComposerFooter.tsx is 986 lines against a 1000 cap; agents cannot raise caps.

autoDecisions.summary: Rail "closed" = the existing 30 px collapsed strip; an unset key means collapsed, a stored "false" still opens (D2-15).
autoDecisions.rationale: The strip carries the rail's width measurement and reopen click; respecting a stored "false" keeps operators who opened it on purpose.

autoDecisions.summary: + menu keycaps come from the registry by shortcut id; mockup keycaps Ctrl N and Ctrl ` are not used (D2-17).
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent D-7 replaced Ctrl N with N; the terminal toggle has no non-mac binding, so showing a keycap would lie.
changelog.d/README.md requires the lowercase issue id; the child stub's 5295.md is wrong.

items.title: Shared dock diff-target helpers diffTargetOf/diffTargetsOf in changes-model.ts (WI-1)

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Add pure diffTargetOf(changes, file, commit, rootPathOf) and diffTargetsOf(changes, rootPathOf) to components/dock/changes-model.ts, returning exactly what ConversationChangesList's inline targetOf/targets return today (path: rootPath ?? file.path, repoPath, repoRoot, sha/pushed for commits, outsideRoot when rootPath is null; uncommitted first, then each commit's files). Import DockDiffTarget with `import type` from ./workDockStore. Switch ConversationChangesList to the helpers with no behavior change.

items.title: Given a ConversationChanges answer with one uncommitted file and one pushed commit, when diffTargetsOf runs, then it returns the uncommitted target first and the commit target with sha and pushed: true (changes-model.test.ts).
Given a repo path outside the dock root, when diffTargetOf runs with a rootPathOf that returns null, then the target has outsideRoot: true and path equal to the repo path.
Given the existing ConversationChangesList.test.tsx, when it runs after the switch to the helpers, then it passes with no test edits.
Group conversation changes by user turn in turnChanges.ts (WI-2)

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 and D2-5/D2-8. New pure module chat/messagesTimeline/turnChanges.ts exporting TurnFileRow, TurnChanges, userTurns(messages) and turnChangesByAnchor(messages, changes). A user turn runs from a role:user message to the next role:user message; role:system does not end it; the anchor is its last assistant id. A card aggregates every commit whose turnId is one of the turn's assistant ids and every uncommitted file whose turnIds contains one; rows are uncommitted first then commits in response order, one row per repo path (first wins); counts per PRD WI-2. Turns with no matching change are absent; null changes gives an empty map. Add the test file to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt in sorted position.

items.title: Given an uncommitted file whose turnIds names a mid-turn assistant id and a commit whose turnId is the last assistant id of the same user turn, when turnChangesByAnchor runs, then it returns one TurnChanges keyed by the last assistant id containing both rows.

Given a role:system message between two assistant messages of one turn, when userTurns runs, then it returns one turn, and two user messages produce two turns; assistant messages before the first user message form their own turn.
Given a path that is both committed and uncommitted in one turn, when turnChangesByAnchor runs, then it returns one row for that path carrying the uncommitted entry.
Given a turn with no matching change, or changes === null, when turnChangesByAnchor runs, then the map has no entry for that turn (empty map for null).

ConversationChangesScope context: one shared /changes query, Stage dock actions, outside-Stage diff window (WI-5)

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5 and D2-1/D2-2/D2-3. New chat/conversationChanges/ConversationChangesScope.tsx exporting StageChangeActions, ConversationChangesContextValue, ConversationChangesScope and useConversationChangesContext exactly as the PRD signature block. Switch the ⋯ "Full diff in a new window" item to pass useConversationChangesContext()?.rootId ?? null. Nothing mounts the scope yet (turn-card-wiring does). Add the test file to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt.

items.title: Given a ConversationChangesScope inside a StageDeckProvider with openDock and openBeside, when a child reads the context and calls stage.openDiff and stage.showInFiles, then openDock is called with { tab: "changes", changesScope: "conversation", diff, diffList } and { tab: "files", filesFilter: "mine" }.
